newsitem.title: USA: Telecheck says holiday spending by check up 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Telecheck says holiday spending by check up 5 pct.

text.p: Telecheck Services, a unit of First Data Corp , on Tuesday said same-store retail sales rose five percent in the first 17 days of the holiday shopping period.

Telecheck, a check acceptance company, said the data was based on a year-over-year, same-store comparison of the dollar volume of authorized checks written by consumers at more than 20,000 of TeleCheck's 160,000 locations.
Checks account for a third of retail spending, the company said.

"Consumers stepped up the pace of their holiday shopping over the past year, resulting in a further improvement on the 3.7 percent same-store sales gain TeleCheck previously reported for the first 10 days of the season," said William Ford, TeleCheck's senior economic adviser.
Ford said retailers were not experiencing the typical midseason holiday lull because the shopping season was shorter this year.
Gains were strongest in the southwestern United States, with a seven percent same-store sales increase, Ford said.
